sourceObject.title: ЧМЭ3 / ЧМЭ3Т / ЧМЭ3Э
sourceObject.defaultProfilePolicy: Не определять исполнение только по общему названию ЧМЭ3. Для действий и схем, зависящих от модификации, требовать подтверждение серии/номера/фактического оборудования.

profiles.title: ЧМЭ3Т — исполнение с электродинамическим тормозом
variantNotes: Компоновка дополнительного оборудования и аккумуляторной батареи различается между партиями.
Электрическая схема существенно отличается от базового ЧМЭ3 из-за реостатного тормоза и дополнительной электроники.

profiles.title: ЧМЭ3Э — электронное управление без реостатного тормоза

profileDimensions.notes: Не кодировать жёсткую привязку по номерным диапазонам как единственную истину до сверки по нескольким источникам и реальному исполнению после ремонтов/модернизаций.

conflictPolicy.rule: Фактическое установленное оборудование важнее предположения по номеру, но не отменяет требования проверить допустимость действия по актуальным документам.
conflictPolicy.fallback: При неизвестном исполнении показывать общую справочную информацию и блокировать вариантозависимые действия.

interactiveSchemePolicy.rule: Every supported profile must expose interactive electrical and pneumatic coverage; every directed flow endpoint must be clickable and profile-safe.

inheritancePolicy.commonContent: Mechanical, diesel, fuel, oil, water, pneumatic and other content may be inherited only where applicability is explicitly confirmed for the profile.
inheritancePolicy.variantOverrides: Electrical/electronic control, layout and variant-only equipment must live in the variant layer when they differ.
inheritancePolicy.noNegativeInheritance: Absence of a variant-only feature is explicit. A profile must never inherit CHME3T rheostatic-brake equipment merely because it shares electronic equipment with CHME3T.
inheritancePolicy.unknownExecution: When actual equipment or modernization is unknown, variant-dependent actions fail closed.

integrationBoundary.rule: READY_FOR_APP_INTEGRATION means the knowledge foundation is internally complete and validated; it does not mean Android repositories, UI, assets or the production assistant index already consume this package.

sourceObject.title: ЧМЭ3Э — электронное исполнение без заводского реостатного тормоза

profileRules.electricalSchemePolicy: Use a dedicated CHME3E electrical layer; shared apparatus may reference family-common entities, but circuit logic must follow CHME3E-specific evidence.
profileRules.interactiveSchemePolicy: Expose semantic-canvas interactive views through the family interactive contract. Source-overlay coordinates require a separately verified image mapping and must never be invented.
profileRules.diagnosticPolicy: Inherit only shared scenarios explicitly applicable to ЧМЭ3Э and add the dedicated electronic runtime-v2 layer. Training/reference sources may localize faults but do not grant bypass/repair authority.
profileRules.acceptancePolicy: Inherit the 20 common family checks subject to applicability; add profile-extended electronic/preheat/remote-control observations without declaring training-derived content a universal network-wide mandatory TO-1 list.
profileRules.edbPolicy: Factory rheostatic-brake content is excluded unless a specific non-factory modernization is independently confirmed for the physical locomotive.
profileRules.modernizationPolicy: Actual installed equipment overrides assumptions from series/number for information routing, but does not grant authority for actions without current source support.
profileRules.unknownExecutionPolicy: Fail closed for variant-dependent operational actions.

numberReference.rule: Number may suggest the factory series but must not be the sole authority after repairs or modernization.

sourceObject.integrationBoundary: This status covers the validated knowledge package only. Android repositories/UI/assets and the production assistant index are not yet wired to consume it.

atlas.strategy: inherit only records whose applicability explicitly contains ЧМЭ3Э

schemes.strategy: inherit only family-common mechanical/diesel/fuel/oil/water/pneumatic functions explicitly applicable to ЧМЭ3Э; electrical circuit logic is overridden by the dedicated ЧМЭ3Э variant layer

hardExclusions: CHME3T rheostatic-brake schemes and runtime actions
sourceObject.integrationRule: A consumer must resolve common records through applicability, then overlay chme3e variant records. It must never copy the entire chme3t layer and subtract EDB heuristically.
